cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll talk about trying again. I'll sit by the door; you take the sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise ten minutes. Leave the way out clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. Let me go tonight without a key, though.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs seating and discussion; A3 commits limited time while retaining an exit; B4 flexibility enables A5 honest hope within the boundary of leaving without a key tonight.

relationship.evidence: B2 worries about abandonment of the conversation and B4 offers stopping rather than forcing a commitment.

heightening.evidence: B4 permission to stop allows A5 to say the vulnerable wish without turning it into immediate action.
